# Sentinel

> Safe, auditable agentic sysadmin tool in Rust. LLM-driven Investigate → Plan → Approve → Act loop with a deny-by-default policy engine, operator approval gate, and hash-chained audit log.

Sentinel is maintained by marcuspat (Agentic Engineer — Platform Engineering × AI-assisted development).

## Links

- [Landing page](https://marcuspat.github.io/Sentinel/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Source code](https://github.com/marcuspat/Sentinel): README, issues, releases
## Install

```
brew install marcuspat/tap/sentinel
```
